newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms against dollar on U.S. trade gap news.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms against dollar on U.S. trade gap news.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar following news of the U.S. trade gap, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Everybody was selling the dollar," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 153.48/53 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 153.99/154.03, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit also closed the 15 pips gap that separated it from the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Swiss franc futures dropped for all maturities and the mark ended lower for four maturities.
The dollar and Ecu finished mixed, the yen eased for two termins, sterling and lira remained unchanged.
Turnover soared to 4.22 billion forints from Tuesday's 763 million.
